title: The Wayward Cloud (bc30)
synopsis: Living a dry and lonely life in drought-stricken Taipei, she spends her time scavenging for water, and he tries to take a bath in the rooftop water tank after a day of porn acting. If life gives them watermelons, make juice and have pulpy sex with them? Injected with deliberately anachronistic and camp musical numbers, Tsai’s tale of love, drought, and desperation mixes sexual frankness and surreal minimalism with aesthetic crudity in an exploration of his characters’ disconnected, existential malaise.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 炎夏，制水。一個身體多麼渴望進入或被進入另外一個身體像兩朵雲相遇，化成雨，滋潤大地。她到處去檢空瓶，偷公廁的水；他拍完A片，半夜爬進天台水箱，只想痛快沐浴。生活雖然艱苦，可是寂寞更加難耐；就化身貼滿鱗片的妖艷人魚，冒出水面唱首〈半個月亮〉，或在蔣介石銅像下搔首弄姿，來一場俗艷歌舞。每個人都是一朵雲，在無言的天空，獨自飄零，彷彿永不相遇。蔡明亮迄今最大膽前衛之作，以色情反色情。
